title: The Roman gods.
lede: Fifteen gods and what each of them looked after. Browse them, hide half of each card to test myself, then let the quiz find out what actually stuck.

card.title: Roman gods
card.desc: Fifteen gods, the areas they ruled over, and the symbols that give them away.

items.name: Jupiter
items.domain: King of the gods; sky and thunder
items.hook: The biggest planet, for the biggest ego. When someone says “By Jove!”, that's him too.

items.name: Neptune
items.hook: The deep-blue planet out at the edge, where the sea goes on for ever.

items.name: Pluto
items.hook: The far-off, cold, dark one, much like his planet. And the gold and silver all lie underground with him.

items.name: Juno
items.domain: Queen of the gods; marriage and childbirth
items.hook: June is still the favourite month for weddings. Her department.

items.name: Ceres
items.hook: Every bowl of cereal is, strictly speaking, an offering.

items.name: Vesta
items.hook: The Vestal Virgins' entire job was making sure her fire never went out. No pressure.

items.name: Mars
items.hook: March was when the legions went back on campaign. The red planet is dressed for the job.

items.name: Venus
items.hook: The brightest thing in the night sky after the moon. Naturally.

items.name: Vulcan
items.hook: A volcano is his forge letting off steam.

items.name: Bacchus
items.hook: A bacchanal is a party that has got wildly out of hand. He'd call that a Tuesday.

items.name: Janus
items.hook: January: one face looking back at the old year, one looking forward to the new.

items.name: Mercury
items.hook: Fastest planet round the Sun, and still delivering flowers on the Interflora logo.

items.name: Minerva
items.hook: An owl in a helmet. Wisdom, but make it tactical.

items.name: Apollo
items.hook: Got the moon missions named after him, though the moon is technically his twin sister's.

items.name: Diana
items.domain: The hunt, the moon and wild things
items.hook: Apollo's twin. He had the sun; she had the moon and a great many nervous deer.
